source: CDC WONDER, Underlying Cause of Death 2018-2024, Single Race (final data); age-adjusted rate per 100,000, 2000 U.S. standard population; ICD-10 113 Cause List
method: Query grouped by Year and ICD-10 113 Cause List with age-adjusted rates enabled, read through a real browser (wonder.cdc.gov refuses non-browser clients). The 2018 and 2019 values equal the Health, United States SlctMort table (14.9 / 12.3 influenza and pneumonia; 1.5 / 1.4 HIV disease), which is the overlap check.
